Verses.Text: Do to no one what you yourself hate. Do not drink wine to the point of drunkenness; let not drunkenness accompany you on your way.
Seek advice from every wise person, and do not think lightly of any useful counsel.
Prayer with fasting is good. Almsgiving with righteousness is better than wealth with wickedness. It is better to give alms than to store up gold.
Blessed be God who lives forever, because his kingdom lasts for all ages.
